name: Arabica coffee (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Arabica coffee (Coffea arabica) [Coffee and coffee products] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: Ky et al. 2001, Food Chemistry 75:223 doi:10.1016/S0308-8146(01)00204-7 (caffeine, trigonelline, chlorogenic acids, sucrose in Arabica)
Acids in coffee: review and meta-analysis, Crit Rev Food Sci Nutr 2022 doi:10.1080/10408398.2021.1957767 (organic acids green/roasted)
Metabolite Profiles of Green Beans of Indonesian Arabica Varieties, PMC8632381 (sugars, acids, alkaloids, amino acids in mM)
Green-coffee proximate composition, Int J Agronomy 2022 art.1317341 (protein, lipid, carbohydrate, ash)
Green Arabica coffee oil fatty-acid composition, PMC8121985; Agronomy 2023 doi:10.3390/agronomy13102560
Green-coffee mineral ICP-OES, Eur Food Res Technol 2025 doi:10.1007/s00217-025-04664-7; PMC6778417 (K, Mg, Ca, Fe, Zn, Cu, Na)
Free amino acids in green coffee, Eur Food Res Technol doi:10.1007/BF01231078
USDA FoodData Central / roasted-coffee panel (niacin ~16.8 mg/100g roasted, tocopherols)
provenance.curation_notes: Curated as green Arabica coffee beans (dry weight); roast-dependent changes flagged per compound (sucrose and chlorogenic acids fall, quinic/acetic/niacin rise). Dominant utilisable carbon/energy substrates for a growth medium are sucrose (~8 g/100g) plus the organic-acid pool (citric > quinic > malic > acetic, ~2.6 g/100g total) and the chlorogenic/quinic acid pool; caffeine (~1.2 g/100g) and trigonelline (~1 g/100g) are largely inhibitory/xenobiotic N compounds rather than favourable substrate
curation_added: sucrose with amount (dominant soluble carbon of green beans)
citric acid, malic acid, quinic acid, acetic acid, lactic acid, formic acid (organic-acid pool - the main FooDB omission)
total protein and major free amino acids (alanine, asparagine, GABA)
total lipid + full fatty-acid breakdown (linoleic, palmitic, oleic, stearic, arachidic)
quantitative minerals (K, Mg, P, Ca, Fe, Mn, Zn, Cu, Na)
niacin with green-vs-roasted note; tocopherols quantified

curation_removed.name: Cholesterol
curation_removed.reason: Animal sterol, biologically implausible in a plant seed; FooDB predicted, not a coffee growth nutrient. Coffee's sterol fraction is phytosterols/diterpenes (cafestol, kahweol).

curation_removed.name: 17alpha-ethynylestradiol
curation_removed.reason: Synthetic pharmaceutical estrogen; absurd as a natural coffee constituent - FooDB predicted/contaminant artifact.

curation_removed.name: Cyanocobalamin
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin B12 is not synthesized by plants/coffee; predicted, not measured. Remove.

curation_removed.name: Retinol
curation_removed.reason: Preformed vitamin A occurs only in animal foods; implausible in green coffee. FooDB predicted.

curation_removed.name: Beta-Carotene
curation_removed.reason: Green coffee beans are not a carotenoid source; entry is predicted/negligible, not a growth nutrient.

curation_removed.name: L-Ascorbate
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin C is minimal in green coffee and destroyed on roasting; predicted rather than a real growth substrate.

curation_removed.name: Phytomenadione
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin K1 negligible in coffee beans; FooDB predicted, not a growth-relevant nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: Non-nutritive trace cobalt; FooDB elemental dump, not a defined coffee nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Trace/contaminant element, not a growth nutrient of coffee.

curation_removed.name: Selenium
curation_removed.reason: Trace, highly soil-variable, not a defining coffee nutrient; drop as noise.

curation_removed.name: Molybdate
curation_removed.reason: Trace micronutrient from FooDB elemental dump; not quantitatively relevant for coffee medium.

curation_removed.name: Iodine c
curation_removed.reason: Not a coffee nutrient; trace/contaminant FooDB entry.

curation_removed.name: Fluoride
curation_removed.reason: Trace, not a growth nutrient; remove.

curation_removed.name: Fe2+ mitochondria
curation_removed.reason: Compartment/redox-state artifact duplicating 'Iron'; consolidated into a single iron entry.

curation_removed.name: Iron (Fe3+)
curation_removed.reason: Oxidation-state duplicate of 'Iron'; consolidated into a single iron entry.

curation_removed.name: Starch C12H20O10
curation_removed.reason: Green coffee stores little starch; its reserve carbohydrates are cell-wall polysaccharides (galactomannan, arabinogalactan). Retain only trace; starch entry is misleading as a major substrate.

curation_removed.name: Dextrin C12H20O10
curation_removed.reason: Not a genuine green-coffee constituent; dextrins are process/roast artifacts. Predicted noise.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
